content.text: even                 Mapping (Mapping<KEY_TYPE, VALUE_TYPE, TRAITS>&& src) = default;
found simple way to reproduce portably:
Mapping<int, int> m{KeyValuePair<int, int>{1, 3}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{2, 4}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{3, 5}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{4, 5}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{5, 7}};
COULD have fixed this with MOVE keeps moving in Iterable with:
BUT - thats too much cost on move, since we use COW anyhow.
So changed Iterable(Iterable&&) to just do copy, and documented design choice
I need a clear policy on move CTOR for containers.
Mapping<int, int> m{KeyValuePair<int, int>{1, 3}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{2, 4}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{3, 5}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{4, 5}, KeyValuePair<int, int>{5, 7}};
should m.clear() work, or assertion failure.
seems to suggest it should work. But that would be COSTLY, and useless.
SO Im leaning towards defining it to be an assertion error.
DISALLOWED to use methods on a container after its  been moved from (see Containers/ReadMe.md).
